title.en: The Rump Court's Grain Registers

desc.zh: 外贝加尔的小朝廷还捧着两本册子：一本记旗丁的月粮，一本记垦户的税粮。册子越旧，欠得越多；先把粮册理清，才谈得上别的。
desc.en: The small court at Transbaikal still holds two registers: one for the bannermen's monthly grain, one for the settlers' tax grain. The older the books, the larger the arrears; only by putting the grain registers in order does anything else become possible.

title.en: Subjects Beyond the Style

desc.zh: 朝廷的名号之下，还住着布里亚特牧户、哥萨克垦户与海岛上的通信人。谁能算朝廷的属民、谁只算客籍，以及往来书信该用谁的名号，将决定留下的究竟是朝廷还是别的什么。
desc.en: Beneath the dynastic style live Buryat herders, Cossack settlers and correspondents across the sea. Who counts as the court's own, who stays a registered guest, and whose name the letters carry, will decide whether what remains is a court or something else.

title.en: The Eight Banners Still Must Eat Grain

desc.zh: 户部的旧册还按月记着旗丁的米粮，可陆上的地租连俸库都填不满。管票的章京把两本册子摊在案上：旗饷一日不改，垦户的税就一日收不齐。
desc.en: The old board register still records the bannermen's monthly grain, yet the land rents on the steppe can no longer fill the stipend stores. The secretary in charge of ration tickets spreads both books on the desk: while the stipend goes unchanged, the settlers' tax can never be collected in full.

title.en: Banner Lands and Plough Furrows

desc.zh: 科尔沁的旗册认牧道，新垦的田契认犁沟，两本册子在同一个旗署里对不上账。盟旗的兵额、租谷的税源、牧道的存废，都要先从这两册并一册说起。

desc.en: With the banner-land and furrow accounts settled, Khorchin faces the league without and the next generation within: whether the mutual guarantee was confirmed, which roll holds the lessees' children, and whose names may sign when the compact is renewed.

title.en: The Roster of Rotating River Duty

desc.zh: 索伦各屯守渡、巡河、传驿的班次都记在一本轮役簿上，可班次越排越空：有人折费代役，有人托亲顶名，有人干脆不上簿。江上的差事一日无人守，皮货与军粮就一日到不了岸。
desc.en: The Solon villages' ferry, patrol and relay shifts are all written in one roster of rotating duty, yet the shifts grow emptier each season: some households pay silver to be excused, some send a kinsman in their name, and some simply leave the book. While no one minds the river, furs and army grain alike fail to reach the landing.

title.en: The Office Between the Villages

desc.zh: 官署的印记落进了村社之间：渡口添了官册与领薪的书吏，村约仍是旧例，城里的年轻人开始候补。轮役簿的账怎么结，决定这本官文书往后由谁来写。
desc.en: The office's seal has settled between the villages: the ferry crossing now keeps a government roll and salaried clerks, the village covenants remain the old custom, and the young in town wait for vacancies. How the roster's account is closed decides who writes this official book next.

title.en: Who Mans the Crossing This Season

desc.zh: 开春的轮役簿摊在案上，渡口的班次还缺三屯。老把头说人手是各屯的命，收银代役是坏规矩；管渡的书办说皮张折役记账清楚，各屯也愿意。这一季该谁守渡，总得有个写进簿子的章程。
desc.en: The spring roster lies open on the desk and three villages' shifts at the crossing stand unfilled. The old boatmaster says each village's men are its lifeblood and taking silver for duty ruins the custom; the crossing clerk says fur payments make clean entries, and the villages themselves would rather pay. Who mans the crossing this season needs a rule written into the book.

title.en: The Wharf Officer Does Not Know the Village Covenant

desc.zh: 码头官按官册罚了一个屯子的皮张，屯长老把村约抬到案上：渡口归这屯守了三代，罚金没有名目。官册写得明白，村约也是真凭据，两头都不肯让。这一案怎么断，往后两岸都照着办。
desc.en: The wharf officer fined a village's furs by the government roll, and the village elder laid its covenant on the desk: the crossing has been that village's charge for three generations, and the fine has no name in it. The roll is plainly written and the covenant is plainly old, and neither side yields. How this case is judged will be followed on both banks.

title.en: The Young Choose to Stay in Town

desc.zh: 领过薪饷的年轻人不回屯了：城里有力工、有书吏的缺、有按月发的饷。屯里轮役的班次却要摊到人，名籍上留着名字，人常在码头。让不让他们考渡口的书吏，簿子得添新页。
desc.en: The young who drew wages do not go back to the villages: town has labor for hire, clerk vacancies and pay by the month. The villages' shifts must still be manned, their names stay on the roster while they stay at the wharf. Whether they may sit for the crossing clerk's post is a new page the roster must add.

title.en: The Last Page of the Duty Roster

desc.zh: 轮役簿写到了最后一页：薪饷的账、村约的案、城里候补的名字都在上面。这一页写完，簿子要么入官册，要么还各屯，要么封存。没有新式工业，也没有大众政党，要紧的只是这本旧簿往后由谁续写。
desc.en: The duty roster has reached its last page: the wage accounts, the covenant cases and the names waiting in town are all on it. Once the page is written, the roster enters the government rolls, returns to the villages, or is boxed away. There is no modern industry and no mass politics; what matters is who continues this old book.
